final: WITH order_avgs AS (SELECT COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NO_ORDER') as ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) as avg_remain FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NO_ORDER')), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) as overall_avg FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL), above_overall AS (SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.avg_remain, ov.overall_avg FROM order_avgs oa CROSS JOIN overall_avg ov WHERE oa.avg_remain > ov.overall_avg), group_avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as second_avg FROM above_overall), final_filtered AS (SELECT ao.avg_remain, ao.overall_avg, gac.second_avg FROM above_overall ao CROSS JOIN group_avg_calc gac WHERE ao.avg_remain > gac.second_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as avg_of_filtered, AVG(avg_remain - overall_avg) as avg_excess_overall, AVG(avg_remain - second_avg) as avg_excess_group FROM final_filtered
